name: Tidepool Astronautics
image_style: Landscape editorial wallpaper painted in gouache, risograph grain, and softly weathered mineral textures; an uncanny coastal-science mood where moonlit tide pools behave like miniature observatories. Use layered matte shapes, delicate ink contours, translucent brine stains, subtle paper fibers, and restrained asymmetry. The palette feels nocturnal but unfamiliar: deep kelp-black, oxidized lilac, mineral apricot, cold sea-glass teal, and small glints of tarnished silver. Keep the upper edge quiet and spacious, with no lettering or typography.
scene: Space Ghost stands ankle-deep in a black tidal basin beneath a low, hazy moon, his white suit reflecting faint apricot and lilac highlights. Around him, tide pools contain tiny rotating galaxies, coral antennae, and glassy orbital rings instead of stars. A stranded brass weather buoy leans in the foreground, trailing delicate luminous seaweed toward the horizon. The composition is wide and calm, with the strongest detail concentrated in the lower two-thirds and an uncluttered dark sky across the top.
